findings.title: A pinned mise-action version ignores cache_key_prefix, so the shared key and the glibc failure come back
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: The mechanism depends on an unverified assumption that the pinned mise-action versions drop cache_key_prefix; the cited YAML and test show nothing of the kind, and head CI is green.

findings.title: Cold cache after merge makes every job recompile its cargo tools
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: The cited cargo tools and fuzz timeout-minutes: 30 exist, but a one-off slow cold-cache run is an expected, self-healing consequence, and head CI shows no timeouts.
